title: ContainerPreview settings
description: Settings reload about every 200 ms. Invalid files retain the last valid settings. Maximum file size: 4096 bytes.

enabled.description: Enable world-container preview and permitted native background opening.

holdKey.description: Hold to preview, not a toggle. Case-insensitive: LALT/LEFT_ALT, RALT/RIGHT_ALT, LCTRL, RCTRL, LSHIFT, RSHIFT, SPACE, A-Z, 0-9 or F1-F24. Input is observed, not intercepted; choose a key that does not conflict with your game controls.
